mission_04: Well done! You have successfully applied log transformation to reduce skewness in right-skewed data. You learned how np.log1p() safely handles zero values and how to measure skewness using scipy.stats.skew. Log transformation is one of the most powerful tools for making data more normal-like, which improves the performance of many statistical tests and machine learning models. Remember that log transformation only works with positive values, which is why log1p (adding 1) is commonly used. For data with negative values, consider other transformations.
